summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, electrical engineer, strong interest in number theory and computational algorithms, engaged in discussions about digital rights and media ownership, active in online communities focused on technology and politics, critical of government surveillance and internet censorship, advocates for informed electorate and transparency in politics, follows developments in climate science and energy technology, interested in automation and its societal impacts, supports open-source software and Linux, has a nuanced view on climate change and human impact, enjoys discussing the intersection of technology and society.
